verdict.rationale: Sprint planning is a fair question for a work-management platform like monday.com, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions sprints, backlogs, sprint boards, or agile ceremonies. The closest items are generic boards, ticket updates and linking GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items, which are adjacent features rather than documented sprint planning and management.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development
